meta.name: Go Go Gadget!
meta.description:
Go Go Gadget! Join our bumbling detective, Inspector Gadget, along with Archie, Sonic, the Super Mario Brothers, and more on their funny and exciting adventures.

Shows: Archie's Weird Mysteries, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Reggie or Not, Archie's Weird Mysteries: It Lives in the Sewers, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dream Girl, Archie's Weird Mysteries: Green-eyed Monster
Available on: Pluto TV
